title: Modeling What Changes: Sparse, Residual World Models for Object-Centric Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.02046v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Monolithic world models predict the entire next state at every step, spending capacity re-predicting the static majority of a scene and injecting error into it. We ask whether explicitly modeling change (a per-object change gate plus a residual delta head that perturbs only the objects the gate flags) is a more effective and interpretable bias for physical prediction and control. On a MuJoCo tabletop pushing benchmark scaling from 3 to 8 objects, the sparse/residual model predicts next-state poses 2.5 to 4.6 times more accurately than a dense multilayer perceptron at 8.6 to 11.1 times fewer parameters, sustains change-detection F1 of 0.80 to 0.87 where the dense baseline is degenerate, transfers across object counts with zero retraining (99.4 percent F1 retention), and reaches about 90 percent of its full-data accuracy with a quarter of the data. translated_title: 建模变化之物：面向以物体为中心的操作的稀疏残差世界模型
translated_abstract: 单体式世界模型在每一步都预测完整的下一状态，将模型容量耗费在重新预测场景中静态占多数的部分，并向其中注入误差。我们探究显式建模变化（即一个针对每个物体的变化门控，加上一个仅对门控所标记物体进行扰动的残差增量头）是否是对物理预测与控制更有效且更可解释的归纳偏置。在一个物体数量从3个扩展到8个的MuJoCo桌面推动基准测试中，稀疏/残差模型预测下一状态位姿的准确度是稠密多层感知机的2.5到4.6倍，而参数量减少8.6到11.1倍；在稠密基线表现退化的情况下，其变化检测F1分数保持在0.80到0.87；无需任何重新训练即可跨物体数量迁移（F1保持率达99.4%）；并且仅用四分之一的数据即可达到全量数据准确度的约90%。在自回归滚动预测中，其误差累积远小于稠密模型，紧贴无运动下限……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 提出一种通过逐物体变化门控和残差增量头来显式建模场景变化的稀疏残差世界模型，在桌面推动任务中以少得多的参数实现了更精确的下一状态预测、更稳健的变化检测、跨物体数量的零重训练迁移以及大幅降低的自回归误差累积。
en_tdlr: Proposes a sparse residual world model that explicitly models scene change via per-object change gates and residual delta heads, achieving more accurate next-state prediction with far fewer parameters, robust change detection, zero-retraining transfer across object counts, and greatly reduced autoregressive error compounding on tabletop manipulation tasks.
